name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: PROACTIVE-ONLY BUILD (v0.6.1): same three-trigger architecture as 0.6.0 (1. compose-window-open -> unconditional CertVerifier rebuild; 2. send button/menu intercepted before the real send -> duplicate-only cleanup, no reinit, original send runs exactly once; 3. shutdown -> duplicate-only cleanup; no retry), and doCleanup() now additionally requires an email address on every candidate cert (tokenName AND emailAddresses.length > 0). A stale cert9.db duplicate can only cause the signing-confusion bug (P1) for a cert someone might actually sign with; our Rust module's CERT_FIND_HAS_PRIVATE_KEY filter only checks for a CERT_KEY_PROV_INFO_PROP_ID property, not a genuinely usable key, so a chain-only helper cert (a CA) can look 'live' without ever being signable. S/MIME always needs an email cert (RFC 5750) and a CA essentially never has one -- filtering here is a zero-cost local check (no extra cert9.db/NSS touch) that also cuts the per-cert SQL lookups doCleanup() does against cert9.db.
